purpose: Complete existing fenced local control records from an exact atomically committed Source completion, without another business write.
source_mode: source_db only for positive atomic evidence; actual runner_ledger has no such evidence and remains unknown
prospective_source_column: optional versioned completion_evidence_json, same selected receipt row, written in the same transaction as every reviewed Source target

completion_envelope.job_digest: canonical digest of the complete original normalized job, including original IDs/idempotency/proposal/proof/scope/attempt; never renewed
completion_envelope.binding_digest: original reviewed execution binding + safe native destination/receipt namespace + source ID + trusted scope; credentials excluded
completion_envelope.result: full parsed native WritebackResult with completed status, exact identity and every atomic member result
completion_envelope.result_digest: canonical digest of the full result; the existing receipt row status/IDs/hash also must agree

original_intent_metadata.source_completion_binding: same exact original binding digest, persisted before the Source mutation boundary using the existing intent store
original_intent_metadata.phase: recorded/applying/reconciliation_required uses the existing state machine, no new queue

production_binding_producer: native admitted runtime derives execution binding/selected writer reference, safe resolved destination and exact receipt namespace before apply; no model/config flag can assert a completion
legacy_behavior: Normal supported old receipt schema may still apply. Missing prospective column, original binding or full envelope supplies no recovery guarantee. No synthetic envelope or new evidence is written during recovery.
inspection: Reconnect using current supported native Source configuration and perform SELECT for the original key only. Validate original full job/binding, row IDs/status/hash, full parsed result, scope/target and semantic/atomic proof. Receipt absence is unknown, not rollback.
authorization: Current authenticated exact RECONCILE authority is distinct from APPLY; original proposal/approval/job and Source binding must remain exact. Expired execution eligibility is never renewed for recovery.
local_completion: Existing control transaction CAS original intent/current unknown receipt to full Source-proven completion, preserving entire original unknown receipt in append-only reconciliation event; proposal/idempotency/job/unknown worker projections update together. Late unknown ACK cannot overwrite proven completion.
idempotency_and_concurrency: One matching completion may win. Repeated identical completed bookkeeping may be observed without new Source effect; conflicting or competing records refuse. A crash inside the local transaction retains either the original fence or the complete bookkeeping, never partial adoption.
forbidden: APPLY or source receipt claim during recovery
row similarity or operator assertion as completion
open_design_constraints: Exact minimal destination binding format and original-intent field must be independently reviewed before broader implementation
Source mode lacking a trustworthy full-bound atomic receipt stays fenced
Shared-store bridge must preserve any additive metadata, or that deployment remains unsupported for positive recovery

destination_resolution.policy: Require explicit nonempty URL username and explicit port; unsupported destinations receive no positive binding
